A small '''region''' was one of the several geographical areas of the<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Adari system/Legends|Adari system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adari]]. It predominantly featured broken hills and [[Water/Legends|freshwater]] lakes, which made it one of the most habitable areas on the planet in comparison with the high, snow-covered [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] covering most of Adari's surface.<ref name="GG12" />
